source: docs/design/handoff-2026-09-06/screens/13-admin.png (artboard image is the authority per SETUP); dc.html id="p13"; README screen 13
notes: Region-composition check for the full page: AppShell + the real AdminDashboard (its own internal Masthead), populated fixture data via .discipline/rendering/audit/mounts.mjs['compose-admin'], no live Supabase project reachable in this sandbox (DEVIATION-LOG.md). The mount now seeds dc.html p13's own four provisional rows as real ProvisionalSource records, so the default landing region renders with data rather than its empty state.

Artboard order, top to bottom: Masthead -> 8-tile stat grid (Workspaces/Sources/Ingest/Coverage/Research pipeline/Community pickups/Runtime/Emission factors), Sources tile SELECTED -> Sources sub-tab bar, 'Provisional review' FIRST and active -> the SOURCES · PROVISIONAL REVIEW card (head, SOURCE/TIER/STATUS/DISCOVERED table with a per-row Approve and the trailing overflow, legend foot, pipeline note) -> Organizations card. Rail, top to bottom: Issues queue, the Companies/Individuals/Newest join/Active-this-month card, Read-only controls.

Lane comp-admin (2026-09-08) closed the region the previous pass logged as NOT FIXED: SourceHealthDashboard's Provisional view rendered a 'Source Intelligence' module (its own header, a B.2 progress bar, a Source Tiers legend, a T1-T7 tile grid, a SECOND tab bar, a source search) where the artboard draws one table card. That view is now the artboard's card, built from the shared parts (SectionRule + the new shared ui/RowTable + TierChip + StateNote + Absence); the module's other views (registry/health/canonical/intersections/themes/obligations), which have no artboard, are untouched. The forbid list below is what stops the old composition coming back.

Actions stay real: Approve/Reject/Re-tier all POST /api/admin/sources/promote, the endpoint the review flow already owned (approve/reject/defer). 'Re-tier = stays provisional' is the artboard's own legend and is exactly what decision 'defer' does, there is no in-place tier write for a provisional row (commit-tier-change returns 409 for kind:"provisional").

Two artboard details are deliberately NOT asserted, both logged in DEVIATION-LOG.md 2026-09-08: the foot's 'All 489 provisional' LINK (the built card is the whole queue, so a link to a fuller list would be a dead control, ruling 1.1, and the text renders the live count instead), and the rail's 'Export queue' button (no queue-export endpoint exists anywhere under src/app/api/admin/; not drawn dead, not invented).

Lane admin60 (2026-09-08) closed the three differences the train-59 fold listed against this artboard. (1) The Sources sub-tab row now sits INSIDE the provisional card's head, on ONE line at 1440, as dc.html p13 draws it: the shared TabRow gained a `placement="card-head"` variant (gap 2, the card's own 16px inset, never wrapping) and a `semantics="tablist"` mode that keeps the role=tab semantics the page always had, and the page passes that one row into ProvisionalReviewTable's new `headTabs` slot instead of rendering a second one above the card. The tab counts render as the artboard's inline '· N' text, not a red pill. (2) ORGANIZATIONS is rebuilt on the shared RowTable with dc.html p13's own track list (1fr 120px 110px 100px 120px 44px), the header and the rows used to be two DIFFERENT grids whose row minimum (~858px) exceeded the content column, which is why LAST ACTIVITY was clipped at the card edge. (3) The ROLES column the artboard does not draw is gone; its data renders in the artboard's own MEMBERS cell, '2 · owners'.

Also this lane: the eight stat tiles carry dc.html p13's own sub-lines verbatim (they had drifted into longer engineering prose), the ISSUES QUEUE rows are in the artboard's order rather than the store's, and PlateCard's head is the artboard's Anton-20 head over a SectionRule instead of the 12.5px bold plate header it used to draw.

Still NOT asserted, both logged in DEVIATION-LOG.md: the foot's 'All 489 provisional' LINK (the built card is the whole queue, so a link to a fuller list would be a dead control, ruling 1.1) and the rail's 'Export queue' button, re-checked this lane by grepping src/app/api and src/lib for a queue-export function: there is none anywhere, so it is not built (ruling 1.1). A forbid row below keeps a dead one from appearing.

The ORGANIZATIONS row's trailing 44px cell is held open and EMPTY: the artboard draws a ⋯ glyph there but the app has no per-org row action, and a control with no function behind it is a defect (ruling 1.1).

Lane adminlayout (2026-09-08) put this page on the SHARED FRAME. The operator reported cards running the full page width under the rail with the tier cards clipped at the frame edge, and named the frame as the cause. Measured: the two COLUMNS were already right (minmax(0,1fr) 300px, align-items:start, the content column at min-width 0), and at 1440 nothing overflowed or overlapped - so the frame was not the whole cause. What WAS wrong at the frame: the page split its padding across a '20px 40px 0' masthead wrapper and a '16px 40px 40px' grid, ran gap 24 where the frame is 28, and collapsed at 960 to a bare 1fr (no minmax floor). And at 1024 the registry body really did overflow its column by 336px and paint under the rail, because its T1-T7 card strip was a Tailwind lg:grid-cols-7 keyed to the VIEWPORT, not to the column. The frame rows below measure the one grid; compose-13-admin-registry measures the rebuilt body.
